title: Bit and length oracle queries
statement: For every finite bit string $x$ and natural number $i$, querying the first oracle on the encoded pair consisting of $x$ and the binary word for $i$ returns the bit of $x$ at position $i$, with false returned when that position is out of range. Querying the second oracle on the same encoded pair returns true exactly when $i<|x|$.
